intro.title: Accent Walls & Decorative Finishes
intro.mainText: Accent walls are one of the most effective ways to transform a space without a full renovation. VV Renovation specializes in decorative feature walls including microcement, marble finishes, stucco textures, and modern wall designs.
intro.secondaryText: We work with homeowners, designers and builders across the Greater Vancouver Area to create unique interior spaces that elevate modern homes and commercial interiors.

items.question: What types of accent walls do you install?
items.answer: We install microcement walls, marble decorative finishes, stucco textures, and fully custom feature walls tailored to your interior design.

items.question: Are accent walls suitable for any room?
items.answer: Yes, accent walls can be installed in living rooms, bedrooms, offices, commercial spaces, and feature areas where you want to create visual impact.

items.question: How long does accent wall installation take?
items.answer: Most accent wall projects take from 1 to 5 days depending on the material, wall size, and complexity of the design.

items.question: Do you help with design and material selection?
items.answer: Yes, we help you choose the right finish, color, and texture based on your space, lighting, and overall interior style.

items.question: Are decorative finishes durable?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use high-quality materials and proper surface preparation to ensure long-lasting, durable and easy-to-maintain finishes.

items.question: Do you work across the Greater Vancouver Area?
items.answer: Yes, we provide accent wall installation services across Vancouver and surrounding areas including Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, White Rock, North Vancouver (City), North Vancouver (District), West Vancouver, Delta, Langley (City), Langley (Township).
